capabilities: worktree__start creates a git worktree and branch, then runs one subagent in it through ToolContext.Subagents with a fixed allow-list
worktree__merge merges the worktree branch back, refuses a dirty target and aborts conflicts (never leaves a half-merged tree)
worktree__clean removes a worktree and its merged branch, refusing while a run is active in it
all git calls run through the core/process service; worktree management stays extension territory
